title: Refresh token returns 401 after expiration
body: The callback accepts a new token but the session middleware rejects it.
label: bug
resolution: Updated token validation to read the rotated refresh-token claim.

title: Add support for organization roles
body: Teams need owner and auditor roles in addition to administrators.
label: feature
resolution: Added a role policy table and organization-scoped authorization checks.

title: Document local OAuth setup
body: New contributors cannot find the callback URL and required environment variables.
label: documentation
resolution: Added a local development section with callback and environment examples.

title: Login page shows blank screen on invalid state
body: An invalid OAuth state parameter throws an unhandled exception in the browser.
label: bug
resolution: Handled invalid state errors and redirected users to the login screen.

title: Expose audit events through API
body: Security teams need a paginated endpoint for sign-in and permission changes.
label: feature
resolution: Added an authenticated audit-events endpoint with cursor pagination.

title: Invoice export times out for large accounts
body: CSV generation exceeds the reverse proxy timeout when an account has many invoices.
label: bug
resolution: Moved export generation to a background job and returned a download URL.

title: Add monthly spend forecast
body: Customers want an estimated end-of-month amount on the billing dashboard.
label: feature
resolution: Added a daily aggregation job and projected current usage through month end.

title: Clarify proration calculations
body: The billing guide does not explain how plan changes affect the current invoice.
label: documentation
resolution: Published proration examples for upgrades, downgrades, and cancellations.

title: Duplicate charges after webhook retry
body: A payment provider retry creates a second charge when the first response is delayed.
label: bug
resolution: Stored provider event ids and made charge creation idempotent.

title: Support annual billing interval
body: Sales needs yearly subscriptions with a discount schedule.
label: feature

title: Search results ignore quoted phrases
body: Queries with quotation marks are tokenized into independent words.
label: bug
resolution: Added phrase query parsing and preserved quoted token groups.

title: Add query syntax documentation
body: Users need examples for filters, exclusions, and exact phrase searches.
label: documentation
resolution: Added a searchable query syntax reference with examples.

title: Provide saved searches
body: Users want to pin frequently used queries to their workspace.
label: feature

title: Index job duplicates documents after restart
body: Restarting a worker reprocesses documents already committed to the index.
label: bug
resolution: Stored source checkpoints and skipped committed document ids.

title: Explain index freshness indicator
body: The dashboard needs documentation for the last indexed timestamp.
label: documentation
resolution: Documented freshness states and the indexing delay budget.
